rationale: Measured from the 2026-07-23 Docker production client build after the mobile marketplace discovery and hydration-readiness changes. JavaScript keeps the existing reviewed global ceilings. CSS now has two controls: a 144 KiB raw / 24 KiB gzip global ceiling and a tighter 8 KiB raw / 1.5 KiB gzip increase from this reviewed baseline. This leaves normal UI work enough headroom without allowing repeated baseline refreshes to grow CSS past the global performance cap. Route-level CSS splitting was reviewed but is not currently practical because Tailwind v4 is generated from one root stylesheet imported by the TanStack document shell; splitting that source would duplicate theme/base layers or require a new extraction pipeline. Revisit splitting if measured route-critical CSS or transfer performance regresses.
